privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey must be titled 'PHQ-9 Mental Health Screening Study 2024'. It must have 'Anonymized responses' set to 'Yes'. There are 3 groups: 'Symptom Frequency' (Array type, 9 sub-questions, 4 scale points: Not at all / Several days / More than half the days / Nearly every day), 'Functional Impact' (Short-text), and 'Demographics' (Radio buttons for Age and Sex). The survey must be in an 'Active' state.
